name: @velaros-ai/system
description: System-space tools for VelarOS hosts: text file read/view/edit, shell command execution, background tasks and interactive consoles, process and port inspection, global search, and the local kernel.
author: VelarOS

scripts.build: bun run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/capabilities/build/fix-esm-extensions.mjs dist && node ../../scripts/build/normalize-package-declarations.mjs
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test spec/acceptance.test.ts test/system.test.ts test/kernel-module.test.ts test/shell-resolution.test.ts test/shell-readiness.test.ts test/git-bash-windows.test.ts test/process-host.test.ts test/process-lifecycle.test.ts test/interactive-console.test.ts test/system-search-visibility.test.ts
